description: mod-invoice-storage configuration template. Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment (tebfcon-mod-invoice-storage revision 15); see ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-invoice-storage container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-invoice-storage container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-invoice-storage container in MiB

java.name: MetaspaceSize
java.description: Metaspace size that triggers the first metaspace GC

deployment.description: State is kept in PostgreSQL; the audit outbox is drained with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and the calendar trigger consumer shares one Kafka consumer group, so replicas can run side by side. Two replicas are recommended for availability.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient for the storage CRUD endpoints.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL host (write instance)

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL port

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL username (sourced from the secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL password (sourced from the secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST_READER
EnvVars.description: Optional read-only PostgreSQL host used by RMB for reads; when unset, reads go to DB_HOST

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT_READER
EnvVars.description: Port of DB_HOST_READER; when unset, reads go to DB_HOST

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum connections per tenant per module instance. Value taken from bugfest; RMB default is 4

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Shared pool across tenants, overriding DB_MAXPOOLSIZE when set. Leave unset: RMB marks it buggy (RMB-1030)

EnvVars.name: DB_CONNECTIONRELEASEDELAY
EnvVars.description: Idle time in milliseconds after which a connection is closed; 0 keeps idle connections forever

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum lifetime of a pooled connection in milliseconds; 0 means unlimited

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of reconnect retries after a failed database connect; 0 disables reconnecting

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTINTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Milliseconds between reconnect retries. Applies when DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS is above 0

EnvVars.name: DB_SERVER_PEM
EnvVars.description: PEM certificate(s) to validate the PostgreSQL server; when set, TLSv1.3 is required

EnvVars.name: DB_EXPLAIN_QUERY_THRESHOLD
EnvVars.description: Queries slower than this many milliseconds are logged with EXPLAIN ANALYZE. Value taken from bugfest; RMB default is 1000

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host for audit events and calendar trigger/match events

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PRODUCER_TENANT_COLLECTION
EnvVars.description: Enables tenant collection topics ({ENV}.Default.{value}.{EVENT}); must match [A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,30} and be the same across modules. Value taken from bugfest; unset means per-tenant topics

EnvVars.name: MAX_REQUEST_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Kafka producer max.request.size in bytes

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables folio-kafka-wrapper entitlement-based filtering of consumed records by tenant

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_TENANT_DISABLED_STRATEGY
EnvVars.description: Action (ACCEPT, SKIP, FAIL) for a record whose tenant is not entitled to the module. Applies when KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ALL_TENANTS_DISABLED_STRATEGY
EnvVars.description: Action (ACCEPT, SKIP, FAIL) when no tenant is entitled to the module. Applies when KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENTITLEMENT_REFRESH_INTERVAL_SECONDS
EnvVars.description: Interval in seconds for the full re-fetch of entitled tenants from the sidecar

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENTITLEMENT_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
EnvVars.description: Timeout in seconds of each entitlement lookup call to the sidecar

EnvVars.name: CALENDAR_MATCH_CHUNK_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Number of invoices in one NOTIFICATION_CALENDAR_MATCH event

EnvVars.name: loadSample
EnvVars.description: Loads sample batch groups and adjustment presets on tenant init; the loadSample tenant parameter takes precedence

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Logical deployment name, used as the Kafka topic prefix; must match the other modules

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: Sidecar URL used by the Kafka tenant filter to look up entitlements. Applies when KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENABLED is true; module default is http://okapi:9130

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options for the module process. -Dhttp.port=8082 moves RMB off its default port 8081, which the Eureka sidecar uses; it must match the sidecar's MODULE_URL. Heap sizing comes from the java block.

EnvVars.name: LOG4J_CONFIGURATION_FILE
EnvVars.description: Location of an external Log4j2 configuration overriding the bundled log4j2.properties

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the sidecar container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the sidecar container in MiB

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Deployment environment identifier. Must match the module's ENV

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the sidecar process

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the backend module the sidecar fronts

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL (host:port) at which the mod-invoice-storage container is reachable from its sidecar

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the mod-invoice-storage module deployed alongside this sidecar
